title: Stardew Valley Farm Planner & Layout Editor | Field & Farm
description: Plan your Stardew Valley farm with eight farm terrain references, 16 editable layouts, sprinkler and scarecrow coverage, building costs and seasonal views.
guideText: Choose one of eight farm terrain references, start with a blank grid or starter structures, or preview one of 16 editable layouts. Check irrigation, scarecrow coverage and base construction costs before committing. The maps use independent artwork and documented reference flags.

title: Stardew Valley Community Center Bundle Tracker | Field & Farm
description: Complete Community Center bundles with a standard checklist, seasonal donation hints and remixed bundle tracking in the private save workspace.
guideText: Track 30 standard bundles and the separate Missing Bundle. A merged private save can add positive donations only when a complete saved definition matches the standard reference. Nonmatching or remixed definitions remain available in a separate custom checklist.

title: Stardew Valley Museum Collection & Layout Tracker | Field & Farm
description: Find all 95 museum artifacts and minerals, track donations, check rewards and arrange a practice layout. Inspect saved positions in the private workspace.
guideText: Discovery is not donation. Filter acquisition routes, review reward milestones, and arrange 95 reference items on a practice grid. In the private workspace, inspect recorded museum coordinates without changing the save. The grid does not reproduce the exact room geometry.

title: Stardew Valley Seed & Geode Predictor | Field & Farm
description: Predict geodes, Golden Coconuts, Mystery Boxes, special mine floors, Traveling Cart stock and seeded events with Stardew Valley reference models.
secondaryKeywords: stardew valley does luck affect geodes
guideText: Compare geode opening alternatives, Golden Coconuts, Mystery Boxes, special Mines floors, Traveling Cart stock and seeded events. Use example IDs on the public site or your own fields in the private workspace. Conditional outcomes and unsupported game mechanics remain documented.

title: Stardew Valley Save & Progress Tracker | Field & Farm
description: Check Stardew Valley collection progress, skills, steps, friendship, orders and achievements. Inspect your save locally in the private workspace.
secondaryKeywords: how many steps have i taken stardew
stardew how many steps have you taken
guideTitle: Inspect a save without uploading it
guideText: Explore the collection overview and reference tools. In the private workspace, inspect and merge recognized save observations, then review individual players, milestones, orders and story markers. Unsupported fields remain unknown.

title: Stardew Valley Crop Profit Calculator | Field & Farm
description: Compare profitable spring, summer and fall crops, planting budgets, harvest quality, rotations, kegs, jars, dehydrators and wine aging.
guideText: Compare seasonal and protected crop profits, expected quality, annual rotations and shared-machine cash flow. The fixed-planting daily economy also models kegs, jars, dehydrators, mill output and wine aging together. Tested policies are not global optima.

title: Stardew Valley Fair Grange Display Calculator | Field & Farm
description: Optimize a nine-item Stardew Valley Fair display. Compare item values, quality and categories, then calculate your Grange Display score.
guideText: Enter actual sale values, quality and Fair categories. In the private workspace, load recognized backpack and optional ordinary chest/fridge candidates; confirm availability and optimize the nine-slot display.

title: Stardew Valley Fish Collection Tracker | Field & Farm
description: Track 72 fish collection entries and compare fishing locations, seasons, times, weather, difficulty and sale prices.
guideText: Filter the recorded main routes and compare detailed location-dependent acquisition references, difficulty and sale price tiers for 72 collection entries. Alternate sources and special bait may change conditions.

title: Stardew Valley Perfection Checklist & Tracker | Field & Farm
description: Track the eleven Stardew Valley perfection goals, estimate weighted completion, review individual missing items and compare multiplayer progress.
guideText: Review eleven weighted goals and individual collection checklists. Inspect reference friendship and Stardrop details; private save observations provide conservative evidence rather than certified exact completion.

title: Stardew Valley Crafting Recipes Checklist | Field & Farm
description: Track 149 crafting recipes, check unlock sources and calculate required materials. Plan crafting batches using local inventory observations.
guideTitle: Prepare a batch of crafting recipes
guideText: Plan direct crafting ingredients and costs, choose Trapper substitutions, and optionally use recognized local inventory observations in the private workspace.

title: Stardew Valley Shipping Collection Checklist | Field & Farm
description: Check all 154 reference shipping items, find missing products by category and season, and export your collection checklist.
guideText: Find the 154 reference entries by category, common acquisition season or source hint. Mark actual in-game shipping, not possession or shop sales. Export the missing list; seasonal hints are not exhaustive.

title: Stardew Valley Cooking Recipes Checklist | Field & Farm
description: Track 81 cooking recipes, unlock sources and ingredients. Plan cooking batches, substitute ingredients and account for stock.
guideText: Review cooking recipes, unlocks, grouped ingredient alternatives and intermediate dishes while deducting available dish stock once. Crafting recipes are listed on the separate crafting page.

title: Stardew Valley Golden Walnut Tracker & Locations | Field & Farm
description: Track all 130 Golden Walnuts across 69 task groups, find regional hints and known tile markers, and plan Ginger Island upgrades.
guideTitle: Track lifetime finds separately from spending
guideText: Review 69 reference task groups for 130 Golden Walnuts. Filter location hints and known coordinate markers, check island upgrades and compare recognized save evidence in the private workspace. Coordinate plots are not original game maps.

title: Stardew Valley Farm Types & Layout Comparison | Field & Farm
description: Compare all eight Stardew Valley farms, terrain flags, starter capacity and layout ideas. Choose a farm for crops, fishing or livestock.
guideTitle: Choose a farm for your priorities
guideText: Compare all eight named farm types, their terrain reference flags, modeled starter occupancy and remaining planning capacity. Open editable farm-specific layouts directly in the planner. Grid counts are reference diagnostics, not exact in-game usable land measurements.

title: Stardew Valley Grandpa Evaluation Calculator | Field & Farm
description: Calculate Grandpa's evaluation points from earnings, skills, friendship and milestones. Check the four-candle threshold and remaining points.
guideText: Enter lifetime earnings, skill levels, friendships and completed milestones. Four candles require at least 12 points in the reference model. Record community center completion and its ceremony separately.

title: Stardew Valley Skills, Professions & Mastery | Field & Farm
description: Compare five skills, 30 profession effects and mastery experience. Inspect recognized skill XP and profession choices in the private workspace.
guideText: Enter skill XP and mastery points, or load recognized main-player statistics and recorded vanilla profession IDs from a merged private save. Profession effects are not inferred from XP.
